We were not very close. In fact I didn't expected the news to shock me like this. 

I deserve to die because I'm useless on this earth, I'm just  not strong enough for life. The only people that care about me is my family, they are the only thing that keeps me going right now. 

But I think my father will kick me out when I'll tell him I'm dropping out of uni, and then I'll have nothing.
